decisions.reason: By 2022 the firm has had time to absorb market feedback on this specialized but closely related trailer niche, so withdrawal risk is limited but still above the core ranges.
The low-bed trailer series sits squarely within the firm's established trailer engineering, production, dealer, and service capabilities, making continued commercialization the likely choice.
The high trailer cover series builds on existing trailer platforms and accessory channels, so the firm can readily refine and sell it with little need for distant new knowledge.

After earlier portfolio rationalization removed the other box car trailer line, this remaining box car trailer series benefits from strong related know-how and a clearer place in the range, though some demand uncertainty remains.
